{{Quote|The ''Tempest''? That's a ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer, isn't it?''"<br />"''Right. From Dulathia. Our guys got out right before the Rebels overtook the place. She delivered some equipment they managed to salvage for us.|[[Dair Haslip]] and [[Nilo (Imperial)|Nilo]]|<ref name="MtZ">{{JournalCite|3|Mission to Zila}}</ref>}}
The '''''Tempest''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] in service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] it was almost destroyed when escaping from the planet [[Dulathia/Legends|Dulathia]] when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated the planet. Under command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Emba]] it carried components for the [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|V-150 anti-orbital ion cannon]] and safely reached [[Garos IV]]. After that it rendezvoused with the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']] at [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] took complete control of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
